The '''Core Tunnel''' was a brightly illuminated tunnel adjoining the [[Carbon-freezing chamber/Legends|carbon-freezing chamber]] on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]]. [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] traversed the tunnel in his pursuit of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] following their initial duel within the carbon feezing chamber. He was prevented from reentering the tunnel by a fast-closing [[Blast door/Legends|blast door]]<ref name="TESB" /> most likely controlled by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Bewil/Legends|Bewil]] who had recently gained control of Cloud City's lift tubes and hatchways.<ref name="CCGrest">{{CCG|set=Cloud City Limited|cardname=Restricted Access}}</ref>
